goal: Step a PrismPM holo container through Docker's lifecycle, so a holo that check refuses never runs and a running container is never removed under it.

app.name: prismpm-container-lifecycle
app.title: Container lifecycle
app.purpose: Give the next state of a prism.containers container from its state, the event (start, finish or remove), the check verdict, whether allowUnverified was given and whether it was created with rm.
limits: It does not open the image: a holo that cannot be opened makes no container, and create rejects.
It does not model a container read back from its store, which cannot be started again because the store keeps no input.
Exit codes are not states; the EXIT_CODES table gives them.

fields.name: state
fields.means: the container's state.status, or removed once its record is dropped

fields.name: event
fields.means: start(), the guest returning or throwing (finish), or remove()

fields.name: verdict
fields.means: whether check passed the holo under the container's policy

fields.name: unverified
fields.means: whether the container was created with allowUnverified

fields.name: rm
fields.means: whether the container was created with rm: true (--rm)

meanings.created: create opened the image; the guest has not run
meanings.running: check passed, or allowUnverified, and the guest is running; startedAt is set
meanings.exited: the run is over: the guest returned or threw, or check refused the holo and startedAt stays null
meanings.removed: the record is dropped; inspect and remove reject with container.missing

rules.why: sdk/npm/prism-code/src/containers.mjs: every call on a removed container fails container.missing
containers.mjs start: a second call while it runs joins that run (inFlight)
containers.mjs remove: a running container is refused with container.running, as Docker refuses it
containers.mjs exit: rm removes the container on exit whatever its code
proposal 348: running to exited when the guest returned or threw
containers.mjs remove: a created or exited container is dropped from its store
containers.mjs run: a refused holo exits at once, and rm then drops it
proposal 348: created to exited when check refused the holo; the guest never ran
proposal 348: created or exited to running when check passed or allowUnverified, as docker start runs it again
an exited container has no guest to finish

app.otherwiseWhy: a created container has not started, so no guest can finish

properties.why: issue 282: run is gated on check, so a refused holo never runs without allowUnverified
a start again is gated on check as the first start is
a running container cannot be removed without force
with rm, the record does not outlive the run

stakeholders.name: Holo developer
stakeholders.text: Runs holos through prism.containers or prism-code run and needs each container's state to say what happened to the guest.

stakeholders.name: Holo operator
stakeholders.text: Runs holos from others and needs a holo that check refuses never to reach the guest unless they said allowUnverified.

concerns.name: Refused holos never run
concerns.text: A container whose holo check refuses moves to exited with startedAt null unless allowUnverified was given.

components.name: prism-code SDK
components.text: The npm package prism-code in PrismPM sdk/npm, whose containers namespace has run, create, start, get and remove.

components.name: Container store
components.text: fileContainerStore: one JSON record per container in PRISM_HOME/containers, mode 0600, written by rename.

components.name: prism-code CLI
components.text: prism-code run, inspect and rm: the same lifecycle with the record on disk.

threats.name: Refused holo runs
threats.text: A holo whose check fails reaches the guest, so unverified code runs.

control.name: Run gated on check
control.text: A start with a refused verdict and no allowUnverified never answers running, proved for every request.

threats.name: Removed container revived
threats.text: A start on a removed container runs it again from an input the store no longer holds.

control.name: Removed is final
control.text: removed is a final state: every step keeps it, as every call rejects container.missing.

threats.name: Stale running record
threats.text: A process that dies mid-run leaves a record that says running, and nothing acts on it yet.
threats.accepted: Proposal 348 leaves it to issue 350, whose ps has to account for a record left running.

quality.text: No start of a refused holo without allowUnverified answers running.
quality.measureText: Acceptance vectors answered running from a start with verdict refused and unverified denied.

quality.text: Each vector answers the state containers.mjs leaves the container in.
quality.measureText: Acceptance vectors whose replayed state differs from the expected one.
